correctness.rationale: From each diamond |a_j|+|x_j|<=1, summing central contributions yields exact P_m={|x_j|<=1, |z|+sum|x_j|<=m}; every listed slab and sign inequality is a genuine facet. Independent coordinate sign and leaf-permutation symmetries force centered axis-ellipsoids by uniqueness. For the inner ellipsoid, constraints b<=1 and a²+mb²<=m² maximize a b^m at b=1 for m>=2, giving a²=m(m-1). For the outer ellipsoid, poles force A>=m and all leaf-sign corners force B>=sqrt(m); A=m,B=sqrt(m contains every vertex orbit with gauge (m-k)^2/m²+k/m<=1. This yields full contacts and the ratio. Independently generated all vertex orbits for m=2..5: 14/46/146/454 vertices and 6/10/18/34 outer contacts, all matching 2*3^m-2^m and 2+2^m; the arbitrary-dimension proof rests on support functions and symmetry, not this enumeration.
